options.name: Auto
options.description: Models chosen by task for optimal usage and consistent quality

options.name: Claude Opus 5.5
options.description: Claude Opus 5.5 model with 1M context window

tools.name: start_presentation
tools.description:
Start here for anything about slides — a new deck, editing or importing a PPTX,
    restyling a deck. Call it before any other sdpm tool.

    Returns the orchestrator role document (how to run the work end to end) plus what
    it needs first: available styles, PPTX templates, and the output directory.
    To translate an existing deck into another language, call start_translation instead.

tools.name: start_composing
tools.description:
Composer entry. You are a composer when your instruction gives you a deck_id and
    assigned_slugs — call this first with those values and the mode.

    Validates the specs, then returns the composer role document, the slide spec for the
    mode, and everything the deck gives you: deck.json, brief, outline, art direction,
    template analysis (template_html in html mode), which slides exist, and your assigned
    slides (plus any override-group head they inherit from, marked read-only).
    specs_ok=false with errors means stop and report.

deck_id.description: Deck directory path, as given in your instruction.
deck_id.title: Deck Id

assigned_slugs.description: The slugs you own. Other slides belong to other composers running in parallel.
assigned_slugs.title: Assigned Slugs

mode.description: Composer mode from your instruction: pptx (slide JSON) or html (slide HTML).
mode.title: Mode

tools.name: start_style
tools.description:
Call first when asked to create or edit a reusable style guide. (To restyle one
    deck, that is apply_style inside the start_presentation workflow.)

    Returns the style role document, the style catalogue, and one style's HTML to imitate.

base.description: Existing style to use as the skeleton; a bundled default when omitted.
base.title: Base

tools.name: start_translation
tools.description:
Call first when asked to translate an existing deck into another language.

    Returns the translate role document, the slide JSON spec, and the source deck's shape
    (deck.json, existing slides, the sibling deck path the variant will use).

language.description: Target language code or name; becomes the -<lang> suffix of the sibling deck.
language.title: Language

tools.name: init_deck_workspace
tools.description:
Create an empty deck workspace (deck.json, slides/, specs/). A step inside the
    orchestrator workflow — after the brief is agreed, before apply_style — not where a
    request starts; start_presentation is. An HTML deck also returns format_notes.

output_format.description: html only when the user asks for an HTML / browser deck; pptx otherwise.
output_format.title: Output Format

tools.name: check_specs
tools.description:
Validate deck.json and specs/outline.md before dispatching composers; ok=false means
    do not dispatch. Checks deck metadata, outline format and fields, TBD markers and the
    assigned slugs. Composers run the same check inside start_composing.

assigned_slugs.description: Slugs about to be dispatched; each must exist in the outline.
assigned_slugs.title: Assigned Slugs

tools.name: analyze_template
tools.description:
Layouts, theme colors, fonts and slide size of a PPTX template. slide_size.ptPerPx
    belongs in deck.json slideSize (arch_diagram reads it).

template.description: Template name (e.g. "blank-dark") or path to a .pptx.
template.title: Template

layout.description: A layout name, to also get that layout's placeholders.
layout.title: Layout

tools.name: generate_pptx
tools.description:
Build output.pptx from the deck workspace (deck.json + slides/*.json). run_python
    already rebuilds after edits; use this for an explicit full build.

tools.name: search_assets
tools.description:
Search icons and images by keyword. With an empty query, lists the available sources
    (icon packs, image libraries) with counts, types and themes.

query.description: Keyword. Empty string lists the available sources instead.
query.title: Query

source_filter.description: Only this source (icon pack / image library).
source_filter.title: Source Filter

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description:
List available PPTX templates (name, source, description, fonts).
    start_presentation already returns this list.

tools.name: list_styles
tools.description:
List design styles — pinned and user styles by default, everything with
    include_all. Names go to apply_style. start_presentation and start_style already
    return this list.

include_all.description: Include styles hidden by the pin filter.
include_all.title: Include All

tools.name: apply_style
tools.description:
Apply a style (and optionally a template) to a deck: writes specs/art-direction.html
    and completes deck.json (template, defaultTextColor, fonts, slideSize). Returns what
    was written, which fields changed and where each value came from — fix anything
    wrong in deck.json with run_python — and style_toc, a line-numbered map of the
    style file for reading the parts you need with run_python read_text.

tools.name: read_guides
tools.description: Read guide documents — focused references to load when a slide or step calls for one. Guides: arch-elements, arch-layout-engine, attachments, aws-design, chart-bar, chart-line, chart-pie, design-review-guide, design-rules, design-vocabulary, freeform, grid, hand-edit-sync, html-deck, import-pptx, setup, slide-html-spec, slide-json-spec, source-material-guide, storytelling-vocabulary, table.

tools.name: code_to_slide
tools.description:
Render source code as a syntax-highlighted block saved to deck/includes/<name>.json.
    Reference it from a slide as {"type": "include", "src": "includes/<name>.json"}.

name.description: Basename of the includes file, without .json.
name.title: Name

tools.name: grid
tools.description:
Compute exact x/y/w/h for a row × column layout from a CSS-Grid style spec; use it
    instead of hand-placing rectangular arrangements. Syntax and examples:
    read_guides(["grid"]).

purpose.description: One line on what the layout is for (shown in the UI).
purpose.title: Purpose

spec.description: JSON string: {"area": {x,y,w,h}, "columns", "rows", "gap", "areas"?, "items"?} — syntax in the grid guide.
spec.title: Spec

tools.name: arch_diagram
tools.description:
Auto-layout an architecture or flow diagram: you describe groups, nodes and
    connections; the engine places nodes, routes arrows and returns slide elements plus
    layout metrics and warnings (0 crossings / pierces = clean). Schema and technique:
    read_guides(["arch-layout-engine", "arch-elements"]).

spec.description: Logical-structure JSON: direction, iconSize, children (nodes/groups), connections — schema in the arch-layout-engine guide.
spec.title: Spec

x.description: Target area left edge in px.
x.title: X

y.description: Target area top edge in px.
y.title: Y

width.description: Target area width in px (diagram is scaled to fit).
width.title: Width

theme.description: dark or light — box-node text colors.
theme.title: Theme

tools.name: read_attachment
tools.description:
Read a user-supplied file or URL as paged, line-numbered text — PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX,
    text, CSV, HTML, JSON — or image metadata. Pure read, nothing is stored.
    Formats and paging: read_guides(["attachments"]).

source.description: Absolute path under the attachment home, or https:// URL.
source.title: Source

offset.description: UTF-8 byte offset into the text to start from.
offset.title: Offset

tools.name: import_attachment
tools.description:
Import a file or URL into the deck's attachments/ so slides can use it: images
    (converted to PNG), PDF/DOCX/XLSX (text + images), PPTX (full deck structure), URLs.
    Idempotent per source. On IMPORT_INCOMPLETE call again with the same arguments.
    Bundle layout: read_guides(["attachments"]).

source.description: Absolute path under the attachment home, or https:// URL.
source.title: Source

filename.description: Filename override; defaults to the source's name.
filename.title: Filename

tools.name: run_python
tools.description:
Run Python inside the deck directory — the way to read and write deck files
    (deck.json, specs/, slides/, includes/). No import or open(); helpers:
    read_json(path), write_json(path, data), read_text(path), write_text(path, text),
    list_files(subdir="."). Writes persist; output.pptx (output.html for HTML decks)
    rebuilds and changed slides are re-rendered and previewed when deck.json, slides/,
    includes/ or specs/outline.md changed. measure_slides measures text overflow on those
    slugs and previews them; HTML decks get static checks plus browser layout / JS checks
    and PNG previews when Chrome or Edge is available.

purpose.description: One line on what this code does (shown in the UI).
purpose.title: Purpose

measure_slides.description: Slugs to measure for text overflow after the code ran — the ones you edited.
measure_slides.title: Measure Slides

tools.name: run_style_python
tools.description:
Run Python for style authoring. Helpers: read_style(name) returns an existing style's
    HTML (bundled or user); write_style(name, html) saves to the user style store
    (name = file stem, no .html). No import or file access; print() for output.

purpose.description: One line on what this code does (shown in the UI).
purpose.title: Purpose

tools.name: hearing
tools.description:
Show the user a card of up to five structured questions; the answers arrive in the
    user's next message. For more than five, call again after the reply.

inference.description: Your reasoning or hypothesis, shown above the questions.
inference.title: Inference

q0.description: Question object: {"type": "single_select" | "multi_select" | "free_text", "text": str, "options": [str] (select types), "recommended": str | [str] (optional), "placeholder": str (free_text, optional)}.
q0.title: Q0

q1.description: Next question; same shape as q0.
q1.title: Q1

q2.description: Next question; same shape as q0.
q2.title: Q2

q3.description: Next question; same shape as q0.
q3.title: Q3

q4.description: Next question; same shape as q0.
q4.title: Q4

prompts.name: sdpm-vibe
prompts.description: Build a deck from material without questions (fast mode).

arguments.name: material
arguments.description: Source material or a URL — what the deck is made from.

prompts.name: sdpm-spec
prompts.description: Shape a deck together in dialogue — audience, message, outline — before it is built (spec mode).

arguments.name: topic
arguments.description: What the deck is about, or the material to start from.

arguments.name: brief
arguments.description: The look you want, a brand, or a reference — anything to start from.

prompts.name: sdpm-translate
prompts.description: Translate an existing deck into another language as a sibling deck.

arguments.name: deck_id
arguments.description: Path (or ID) of the deck to translate.
